properties.title: In blow to Meloni, Italy misses early exit from EU fiscal watch
properties.summary: BRUSSELS — Italy’s government has failed to rein in its public spending enough to shake off EU fiscal oversight in a blow to Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni ahead of next year’s general election. The Italian National Institute of Statistics today confirmed that the gap between the country’s public expenditure and revenues last year was 3.1%, above the EU’s budget deficit cap of 3% under the bloc’s rules for public spending. properties.summary: Eight people were injured after shots were fired with a hunting rifle near a secondary school in Manisa’s Turgutlu district. The suspect who fled was caught on security camera.

properties.title: Former Romanian presidential candidate Georgescu detained on suspicion of fraud
properties.summary: Former presidential candidate Călin Georgescu was detained Monday on suspicion of fraud by Romanian police and the Directorate for Investigating Organized Crime and Terrorism (DIICOT). The ultranationalist politician shot to prominence when he unexpectedly won the first round of the November 2024 presidential election, snapping up 23% of the vote . properties.title: Greek stock market joins world’s leading exchanges after debt crisis
properties.summary: The Greek stock market joined FTSE Russell’s developed-market group on Monday, potentially attracting more international investment, while recent credit rating upgrades reflect the country’s improving public finances.

properties.title: Russia’s secret plan to supercharge kamikaze drone production
properties.summary: Moscow is moving to expand its capacity to make tens of thousands of the killer drones it deploys in attacks on Ukrainian cities, according to plans from a Russian state company obtained by POLITICO. The expansion of state firm Rosatom’s Alabuga-Volokno factory in Russia’s Tatarstan region would allow Moscow to make an additional 500 tons of military-grade aerospace carbon fiber each year by 2029.
